expectedChanges: Add Guide Ready as a formal sixth release readiness condition.
Require every open WORKS entry in the checked repository snapshot to have valid guide metadata so it automatically appears in the guide terminal all-work and mood flows.
Require selected release targets to have a canonical assets/works/<id>/ogp.jpg or icon.png guide image before release validation can pass.
Keep WORK_GUIDE_FEATURED manually curated; new works are not automatically featured.
Expose guide metadata reading through the Release Validator test API and add regression coverage for missing or invalid guide configuration.
plan.promotion: Staging validator/documentation change only. Production repository is out of scope.
hqDecisions: Guide Ready is a sixth Ready rather than being folded invisibly into Town Ready.
Open staging works must have guide metadata immediately; this prevents a new open work from silently disappearing from the terminal.
Canonical guide image is a selected-release gate, not an all-open staging gate, so an unpublished staging work can exist temporarily with runtime text fallback.
Featured placement remains an explicit human curation decision and is not required for Guide Ready.
alternativesRejected: Automatically insert every new work into WORK_GUIDE_FEATURED.
Require canonical guide images for every open staging work immediately, which would retroactively block the currently unpublished CoffeeFactory staging state.
Rely on manual release checklists without a static validator gate.
boundaryCases: An open work with no WORK_GUIDE_META entry fails even when it is not in the selected --ids list.
A guide entry with empty duration, empty guideLine, no moods, duplicate moods, or unknown mood id fails.
A featured id must be valid, unique, open, and guide-configured, but a new work need not be featured.
A selected work with neither canonical ogp.jpg nor icon.png fails Guide Ready.
An unselected open staging work with valid metadata but no canonical image may remain in staging and use runtime text fallback.
Existing nine published staging validation targets continue to pass because they already have canonical guide images.
testPlan: Run node --check on tools/release-validator.cjs and tests/test-release-validator.cjs.
Run the current staging Release Validator command for the published nine-work set.
Verify all ten current open staging works satisfy guide metadata, including CoffeeFactory.
Verify missing metadata and missing selected image fixtures fail with guide-specific check codes.
Run Scope, Risk, and Impact gates from the immutable Plan Lock.
plan.problem: The new guide terminal only displays open works that also have WORK_GUIDE_META, but the release process does not yet enforce that metadata. A new work can therefore be opened successfully while remaining absent from the guide terminal.
plan.currentContract: WORKS controls open status and the guide runtime filters open works by the presence of guide metadata. Release Validator currently enforces town awareness, search/share, launch, assets, and other release contracts but does not read data/work-guide-meta.js.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: The terminal behavior is correct at runtime, but there is no static release gate connecting status=open to guide metadata and guide image readiness. This leaves an easy operational omission.
plan.design: Teach Release Validator to read and validate WORK_GUIDE_MOODS, WORK_GUIDE_FEATURED, and WORK_GUIDE_META. Validate metadata for every open work in the snapshot, validate featured references, and require a canonical guide image for selected release targets. Document Guide Ready as the sixth Ready.
plan.migration: No runtime or work data migration. Current open staging metadata already covers all ten open works. The existing published nine works already have canonical OGP/icon assets.
plan.compatibility: The guide terminal runtime and recommendation behavior do not change. Existing production publication-set rules, Search/Share generation, Town Ready, Observe Ready, and Release Ready semantics remain intact except that documentation now names six Ready conditions.
plan.rollback: Revert the validator/test/documentation implementation commits after the immutable Plan Lock commit. No runtime or work data rollback is required.
plan.promotionRisk: Production repository remains untouched. A later promotion of this validator contract must preserve the same data files and publication-set semantics.
